 Ric Flair Says He’s Dealing With A Blood Cot In His Leg 
 Jeremy Lambert October 23, 2026, 11:07 am 
 Facebook 
 X 
 Bluesky 
 Ric Flair gives an update on his health.
 On social media, Flair announced that he had to cancel an upcoming appearance as he is dealing with blood cots in his legs.
 From Ric:
 I Want To Sincerely Apologize To My Agent, Steve Solomon, Washington State Horror Con @wahorrorcon, @bigeventny, And Especially All My Fans In Seattle For Having To Cancel My Scheduled Appearance. 
 Unfortunately, I Am Dealing With A Blood Clot In My Leg, And My Doctors Have Limited My Travel To 3–4 Hours. Seattle Falls Outside That Range, And As Disappointed As I Am, I Have To Put My Health And Recovery First. 
 Blood Clots Are Extremely Serious And Can Be Life-Threatening. We Have Seen This Recently With Jalen Hurts And The Complications Involving Blood Clots In His Lungs. It Is A Reminder That This Is Not Something To Take Lightly, And I Must Follow Medical Advice. 
 I’m Scheduled To Have A Procedure To Strip The Affected Vein, Which My Doctors Expect Will Allow Me To Be Cleared For More Travel Afterward. 
 Please Know This Decision Was Not Made Lightly. I Am Truly Sorry For The Inconvenience And Disappointment, And I Am Incredibly Grateful For Your Patience, Understanding, And Continued Support. 
 I Look Forward To Getting Healthy And Seeing You All Down The Road. Thank You For The Love And Support. 
 Much Love, 
 Ric Flair 
 I Want To Sincerely Apologize To My Agent, Steve Solomon, Washington State Horror Con @wahorrorcon , @bigeventny , And Especially All My Fans In Seattle For Having To Cancel My Scheduled Appearance.
